name: dated-folder
title: Dated Folder
description: Create a folder named after today's date and open it in your terminal
author: fhf1121

commands.name: create-dated-folder
commands.title: Create Dated Folder
commands.subtitle: Dated Folder
commands.description: Create a folder named after today's date inside the configured parent folder and open it in a terminal

preferences.name: parentDir
preferences.title: Parent Folder
preferences.description: Where dated folders are created. Defaults to a "temp" folder on your Desktop when left empty.

preferences.name: terminal
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: App used to open the new folder. Follows the system default terminal when left empty.

preferences.name: dateFormat
preferences.title: Folder Name Format
preferences.description: Tokens: yyyy, MM, dd, HH, mm, ss. Wrap words in single quotes to keep them literal, e.g. 'summer'-yyyy. Use / to create nested folders, e.g. yyyy/MM/dd.

preferences.name: revealInFinder
preferences.title: Reveal
preferences.description: Also reveal the new folder in Finder after opening it in the terminal.
preferences.label: Reveal the folder in Finder

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
